# Francis Irabor

> Francis Irabor is a motion designer and 3D artist who creates launch films, product visuals and social content for tech and consumer brands. He is available for freelance projects and full-time roles, working remotely with teams in the US, UK, Canada and Australia.

## Pages
- [Home](https://francisirabor.com/): overview, selected work, process and contact
- [Work](https://francisirabor.com/work.html): featured projects and the full portfolio by discipline
- [Services](https://francisirabor.com/services.html): motion graphics, 3D product design and animation, 3D visualization, brand and graphic design, illustration
- [About](https://francisirabor.com/about.html): background, what he brings to a team, availability
